== English Virtual Original comparison ==
The early response is narrowly to ignore a destiny draw for Tauntaun Bones. The later response can cancel any result of Tauntaun Bones. The original printed Bones has a table of results from the opponent’s destiny draws; its Virtual copy has effects with no drawn destiny. Period rules treat both titles as the same for gameplay, so the changed response scope matters. The creature-vehicle power and Tauntaun battle destiny boosts stay.
